### Bio:

Hi! I’m Jiawen (Kleven) Deng, a first-year MDSH student from Macau. I did my bachelor’s in Marketing at Macao Polytechnic University, then moved into data science through internships and competitions—analyzing student data, building dashboards, and working on health-related projects. I’m interested in health data science and public health. In my free time, I enjoy K-pop, F1, movies, and connecting with people from all over the world. Happy to be here!
